home.title: One read-only JSON file is your whole video library
home.lead: Pure front end, no server: list your videos and playlists in configs.json and tdvideo turns it into a full player — progressive MP4 or HLS, optional WebVTT subtitles and bullet comments, with continue-watching progress in this browser.

notes.videos: Your videos — the primary catalog array
notes.id: Unique key; playlists refer to videos by it
notes.title: Display title shown in Videos and Now Playing
notes.url: Media URL or site path (MP4 or .m3u8); needs CORS when cross-origin
notes.posterUrl: Poster for the Videos gallery; placeholder when omitted
notes.autoDisplaySubtitles: Show the preferred subtitle when playback starts
notes.subtitles: WebVTT tracks; leave out if you have none
notes.subtitleUrl: WebVTT file URL or site path
notes.subtitleLanguage: BCP 47 language tag for the track
notes.bulletComments: Timed overlay comments; leave out if unused
notes.bulletUrl: JSON URL: array of { time, text }
notes.playlists: Your playlists; leave out if you have none
notes.playlistTitle: Display name in Playlists and Now Playing
notes.playlistVideos: Video ids from videos[], in play order

noServer.title: No server
noServer.description: tdvideo is a static site that only reads your JSON and media files. No database, no account, nothing uploaded.

yourData.title: Your library, your file
yourData.description: Edit one file to change videos and playlists. Host it on GitHub Pages, object storage, or any static host, then point Settings at it.

history.title: Continue where you left off
history.description: Watch progress for videos and playlists stays in this browser so Home can resume without a backend.

nowPlaying.empty: Nothing is playing yet. Open a video or playlist to get started.
nowPlaying.missingItem: The selected video or playlist is not in the loaded configs.

videos.title: Videos
videos.empty: No videos in the loaded configs.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.empty: No playlists in the loaded configs.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure the configs.json URL. Leave empty or use the default path to load /configs.json.
settings.clearCacheDescription: This removes cached configs and other Cache Storage data for tdvideo in this browser. Watching history in IndexedDB is kept.

feedback.confirmBody: You will open GitHub in a new tab to file an issue.
